description: Source code for GpuVideoDecodeAcceleratorHost class managing GPU video decoding via IPC in Chromium project.

classes.name: GpuVideoDecodeAcceleratorHost
classes.description: Manages GPU video decoding process, IPC communication, and client notifications.

methods.name: GpuVideoDecodeAcceleratorHost
methods.description: Constructor initializing the host with GPU command buffer implementation.

methods.name: ~GpuVideoDecodeAcceleratorHost
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up observers.

methods.name: OnDisconnectedFromGpuProcess
methods.description: Handles GPU process disconnection, resets decoder and client receiver.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration and client, sets up IPC.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Sends a bitstream buffer to the decoder for decoding.

methods.name: AssignPictureBuffers
methods.description: Provides picture buffers to the decoder.

methods.name: ReusePictureBuffer
methods.description: Reuses a picture buffer after display.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the decoder pipeline.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder.

methods.name: SetOverlayInfo
methods.description: Sets overlay information for video rendering.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the host object.

methods.name: OnWillDeleteImpl
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the implementation is about to be deleted.

methods.name: PostNotifyError
methods.description: Posts an error notification to the client.

methods.name: OnInitializationComplete
methods.description: Notifies client of initialization success or failure.

methods.name: OnBitstreamBufferProcessed
methods.description: Notifies client that a bitstream buffer has been processed.

methods.name: OnProvidePictureBuffers
methods.description: Provides picture buffer info to the client.

methods.name: OnDismissPictureBuffer
methods.description: Informs client to dismiss a picture buffer.

methods.name: OnPictureReady
methods.description: Notifies client that a picture is ready.

methods.name: OnFlushDone
methods.description: Notifies client that flush is complete.

methods.name: OnResetDone
methods.description: Notifies client that reset is complete.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error notification and invalidates weak pointers.
